title: Review sheet stored answer
description: The document a review sheet page stores for one card, in the sheet's own store. The collection is answers, with one document per card id at answers/<card id>, and each document is written whole on every change. The owner's last tap counts, and the answer is null only when a note was saved before any pick.

answer.description: What the owner tapped: aligned, discuss, option for a pick of one of the card's options, or null when nothing was picked yet.

optionId.description: The id of the picked option, or null. It is a string exactly when the answer is option.

note.description: The owner's note on the card, an empty string when there is none.
